eyebrow: The env vars you'll actually see on solara-train
code:
export NCCL_SOCKET_IFNAME=eth0
export NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0
export NCCL_IB_HCA=mlx5
export NCCL_DEBUG=INFO
caption: NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0 keeps InfiniBand in play — never flip this to 1 in production.

code:
NCCL INFO NET/IB : Using [0]mlx5_0:1/IB
[1]mlx5_1:1/IB ...
NCCL INFO Channel 00/04 : 0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7
caption: NET/IB confirms InfiniBand was selected. NET/Socket instead means something's misconfigured.
